messages:
Maria Chen: Heads up — today's invoice batch (2026-03-23 04:00 UTC) had a problem. GPU usage lines were skipped for three accounts (Clearline, ApexTech, Nova Labs). Also ApexTech ended up with two invoices for the same period. @Aj can you triage?
Aj Patel: Ack, on it. Which invoice IDs? Any logs from the generator?
Maria Chen: Invoice IDs: invoice_809331 (Clearline), invoice_809338 (ApexTech-1), invoice_809339 (ApexTech-2), invoice_809340 (Nova Labs).
Maria Chen: Error snippet from billing-worker logs:
```
2026-03-23T03:58:12Z billing-worker ERROR aggregate_gpu: dropped_agg_for_customer=apextech reason="empty-aggregation-after-filter"
2026-03-23T03:58:12Z billing-worker INFO invoice_emit: invoice_id=invoice_809338 generated_lines=4 expected_lines=7
```
Maria Chen: Looks like the aggregator applied a filter that removed small-bucket GPU samples; config says `filter_small_buckets=true` but it should only be applied for nightly-preview.
Rohit Varma: Possible cause: recent change to time-windowing in metrics ingestion. Small buckets for GPU can be non-zero but under threshold; aggregator treats them as noise. I can run a quick query to confirm missing usage.
Rohit Varma: SQL to surface gaps: `SELECT customer_id, sum(gpu_seconds) as gpu_s, count(*) as samples FROM gpu_usage WHERE period_start >= '2026-03-01' AND period_end <= '2026-03-23' GROUP BY customer_id HAVING sum(gpu_seconds) > 0 AND sum(gpu_seconds) < 10;`
Maria Chen: Ran it — ApexTech has 6.2 gpu_seconds aggregated into tiny buckets that were filtered out. Clearline 0.8 and Nova Labs 1.4.
Sam Ortega: For ApexTech, they got two invoices. Which one is live? Are both in `sent` state?
Maria Chen: Both are in `generated` state; one was a retry when the upstream batch job timed out and later succeeded. We need to void the bad one before sending, and reissue corrected lines for all three customers.
Aj Patel: Plan: 1) disable `filter_small_buckets` in nightly path, 2) re-run aggregator for affected customers to produce corrected usage CSV, 3) void duplicate invoice_809339, 4) create corrected invoice and send. Approvals?
Sam Ortega: Finance approves rebill for under-reported GPU usage < $50 per customer as exception. For duplicates we need manager sign-off to void. I'll handle ApexTech manager approval and notify support to prep a customer note.
Maria Chen: I'll kick off re-aggregation now for those three customer_ids (clearline, apextech, novalabs). Sharing the command I'm using: `./scripts/reaggregate --customers clearline,apextech,novalabs --window 2026-03-01:2026-03-23 --force-include-small`
Aj Patel: When you have the regenerated CSV, post it here and I'll run the invoice emitter in dry-run, confirm line counts match expected, then emit live.
FinanceBot: automated: rebill-queue updated — job queued by Maria Chen for customers [clearline, apextech, novalabs], expected ETA 12m.
Maria Chen: Re-aggregation finished. Dry-run shows expected_lines: Clearline=3->added 1 gpu line, ApexTech merged two invoices into one (should be invoice_809341), Nova Labs added 1 gpu line. Posting diff snapshot.
Maria Chen: Diff (summary): Clearline +1 GPU line, ApexTech -2 (merged) +1 corrected GPU line, Nova Labs +1 GPU line. Total estimated delta across three customers: ~$112 credit owed to us (positive revenue).
Aj Patel: Sounds good. I'll proceed with voiding invoice_809339 and emit invoice_809341 after Sam confirms manager approval.
Sam Ortega: Manager approved void for ApexTech. Go ahead.
Maria Chen: Done — voided invoice_809339 and emitted invoice_809341. Notifications queued to customers.
FinanceBot: automated: invoice_809339 status=voided by=Aj Patel; invoice_809341 status=sent by=Aj Patel.
Sam Ortega: Thanks team. Please add this to the postmortem backlog; we should add a guard in CI to prevent `filter_small_buckets` from flipping in production builds. :eyes:
Maria Chen: Agree, filing PM ticket now and tagging eng-runtime for follow-up.
